notes.title: SEX feat Ned Development Progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Shanaz here with good news regarding the SEX feat Ned development,

Our (my) hiatus is officially over and I have started to continue work on the game,
I have been making some substancial progress and I hope to share it all with you soon!
Check out our new instagram page here!, I will be shitposting and also giving updates on the game on the instagram as well as here! It's also good for promoting to people that the game is indeed on track for release sometime this year and to grow awareness building up to launch.

Speaking about the launch
- I don't want to say toooo much right now and commit to something I can't deliver
- I do have potentially really good news but I don't want that to backfire on me later
- Regardless, development is steady and one thing I can say with confidence is that the game WILL most likely be launching this year, where abouts in the year as I said above I have an idea but don't want to mislead people.

Expect a new trailer out later this week!
Thanks for all your support!!! <3
- shanaz
